questions.stem: Expand \[\begin{gathered}(p-1) \\ \cdot (p^{2}+1)\end{gathered}\]
questions.solution:
Remove brackets or distribute products, then combine like terms.
The result is \[\begin{gathered}p^{3} - p^{2} + p \\ - 1\end{gathered}\]
questions.solutionZh:
去括號或用分配律展開，再合併同類項。
結果為 \[\begin{gathered}p^{3} - p^{2} + p \\ - 1\end{gathered}\]

questions.stem:
Simplify and arrange in descending powers of \(x\).
(a) \[\begin{gathered}(5-2 x) \\ -(3 x^{2}+7+2 x) \\ +(3 x^{2}-2)\end{gathered}\]
(b) \((3 x^{2}-4)\) minus \(\left[\begin{gathered}(3x-2) \\ +(2x^2-x+3)\end{gathered}\right]\).
questions.stemZh:
化簡，並按 \(x\) 的降冪排列。
(a) \[\begin{gathered}(5-2 x) \\ -(3 x^{2}+7+2 x) \\ +(3 x^{2}-2)\end{gathered}\]
(b) \((3 x^{2}-4)\) 減去 \(\left[\begin{gathered}(3x-2) \\ +(2x^2-x+3)\end{gathered}\right]\)。
questions.solution:
(a) The quadratic terms cancel; linear terms sum to \(-4x\) and constants to \(-4\). Answer: \(-4x-4\).
(b) First the inner bracket is \(2x^2+2x+1\). Subtracting gives \(x^2-2x-5\).
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 二次項抵消，一次項合共 \(-4x\)，常數項合共 \(-4\)，得 \(-4x-4\)。
(b) 先化簡內括號為 \(2x^2+2x+1\)，相減得 \(x^2-2x-5\)。

questions.stem:
(a) Simplify \[\begin{gathered}(2 p^{2}-4 p q+q^{2}) \\ +(2 p q-p^{2}+3 q^{2}) \\ +10 p q\end{gathered}\]
(b) Hence find its value when \(p=-1\) and \(q=2\).
questions.stemZh:
(a) 化簡 \[\begin{gathered}(2 p^{2}-4 p q+q^{2}) \\ +(2 p q-p^{2}+3 q^{2}) \\ +10 p q\end{gathered}\]
(b) 從而求當 \(p=-1\)、\(q=2\) 時上式的值。
questions.solution:
(a) Collect the \(p^2,pq,q^2\) terms to obtain \(p^2+8pq+4q^2\).
(b) Substitute: \(1-16+16=1\).

questions.stem: Expand \((a+1)\cdot (a-7)\).
questions.solution: Distribute each term over the second bracket, then collect like terms. The result is \(a^{2} - 6 a - 7\).
questions.solutionZh: 將第一個括號每一項分配到第二個括號，再合併同類項，結果為 \(a^{2} - 6 a - 7\)。

classification.difficultyReason: Expand two binomials and collect terms.

questions.stem: Expand \[\begin{gathered}(x^{2}+2 x+1) \\ \cdot (4 x-3)\end{gathered}\]
questions.solution: Distribute each term over the second bracket, then collect like terms. The result is \[\begin{gathered}4 x^{3} + 5 x^{2} \\ - 2 x - 3\end{gathered}\]
questions.solutionZh: 將第一個括號每一項分配到第二個括號，再合併同類項，結果為 \[\begin{gathered}4 x^{3} + 5 x^{2} \\ - 2 x - 3\end{gathered}\]

questions.stem:
(a) Expand \((x^2+2x+1)(x-1)\).
(b) Find the degree of the expansion in (a).
(c) Find the coefficient of \(x^2\) in the expansion in (a).
questions.stemZh:
(a) 展開 \((x^2+2x+1)(x-1)\)。
(b) 求 (a) 中展開式的次數。
(c) 求 (a) 中展開式的 \(x^2\) 項係數。
questions.solution:
(a) Distribute and collect: \(x^3+x^2-x-1\).
(b) The highest power is \(3\).
(c) The coefficient of \(x^2\) is \(1\).
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 用分配律展開並合併，得 \(x^3+x^2-x-1\)。
(b) 最高次冪為 \(3\)。
(c) \(x^2\) 的係數為 \(1\)。

classification.difficultyReason: Link cubic expansion to the degree and coefficient requested in two following subparts.

(c) 求 (a) 中展開式的 \(x^2\) 項係數。

questions.stem: When a polynomial \(f(x)\) is divided by \(2x+1\), the remainder is \(R\). Find the remainder when \(f(2x+1)\) is divided by \(4x+3\).
questions.solution: The given remainder is \(f(-\frac12)=R\). The new divisor vanishes at \(x=-\frac34\), where \(2x+1=-\frac12\). Thus the new remainder is \(R\).
questions.solutionZh: 已知 \(f(-\frac12)=R\)。新除式的零點為 \(x=-\frac34\)，此時 \(2x+1=-\frac12\)，所以新餘式仍為 \(R\)。

questions.stem: Let \(f(x)\) be a polynomial with \(f(2)=-6\). Which expression must have the factor \(2x+1\)?
questions.stemZh: 設 \(f(x)\) 為多項式，且 \(f(2)=-6\)。下列哪個式子必定有因式 \(2x+1\)？
questions.solution: Set \(x=-\frac12\). Then \(2x+3=2\), so \[\begin{gathered}f(2x+3) +6 =f(2) +6 \\ =0\end{gathered}\] By the factor theorem, option D has the factor \(2x+1\). The other choices need information about \(f(0)\) or give \(-12\).
questions.solutionZh: 代入 \(x=-\frac12\)，得 \(2x+3=2\)，所以 \[\begin{gathered}f(2x+3) +6 =f(2) +6 \\ =0\end{gathered}\]由因式定理，D 必有因式 \(2x+1\)。其他選項須知道 \(f(0)\) 或得到 \(-12\)。

questions.stem: Let \(f(x)=2x^2+3x-5\) and \(g(x)=f(x^2+1)\). Find the remainder when \(g(x)\) is divided by \(x-3\).
questions.solution: The remainder is \(g(3)=f(10)\). Hence \[\begin{gathered}2(10)^2 +3(10) -5 \\ =225\end{gathered}\]
questions.solutionZh: 餘式為 \(g(3)=f(10)\)，所以 \[\begin{gathered}2(10)^2 +3(10) -5 \\ =225\end{gathered}\]

questions.stem: Let \(g(x)\) be a polynomial divisible by \(x+1\). Then \(g(4x-5)\) must be divisible by which expression?
questions.stemZh: 設多項式 \(g(x)\) 可被 \(x+1\) 整除，則 \(g(4x-5)\) 必可被下列哪個式子整除？
questions.solution: Since \(g(-1)=0\), solve \(4x-5=-1\) to get \(x=1\). Thus \(x-1\) is a factor.

questions.stem: Let \(f(x)=2x^2+ax-2\), where \(a\) is a constant. If \(f(x)\) is divisible by \(2x-1\), find the remainder when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x-a\).
questions.stemZh: 設 \(f(x)=2x^2+ax-2\)，其中 \(a\) 為常數。若 \(f(x)\) 可被 \(2x-1\) 整除，求 \(f(x)\) 除以 \(x-a\) 的餘式。
questions.solution: \(f(\frac12)=0\) gives \[\begin{gathered}\frac12 +\frac a2 \\ -2 =0\end{gathered}\], hence \(a=3\). The required remainder is \(f(3)=18+9-2=25\).
questions.solutionZh: 由 \(f(\frac12)=0\) 得 \[\begin{gathered}\frac12 +\frac a2 \\ -2 =0\end{gathered}\]，所以 \(a=3\)。所求餘式為 \(f(3)=18+9-2=25\)。

questions.stem: Let \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =2x^3 +px^2 \\ -2qx -25\end{gathered}\], where \(p,q\) are constants. If \(f(x)\) is divisible by \(x-5\) and \(2x+1\), find the remainder when it is divided by \(x+1\).
questions.stemZh: 設 \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =2x^3 +px^2 \\ -2qx -25\end{gathered}\]，其中 \(p,q\) 為常數。若 \(f(x)\) 可被 \(x-5\) 及 \(2x+1\) 整除，求它除以 \(x+1\) 的餘式。
questions.solution: \(f(5)=0\) gives \(5p-2q=-45\). \(f(-\frac12)=0\) gives \(p+4q=101\). Solving yields \(p=1,q=25\). Then \[\begin{gathered}f(-1) = -2 +1 +50 \\ -25 =24\end{gathered}\]

questions.solution: Expansion gives \(-6x^2-x+1\), so the requested coefficient is \(-6\).

questions.stem: After expanding \((4a^2-b+5)(-a+2)\), which option correctly gives the degree and number of terms, in that order?
questions.stemZh: 展開 \((4a^2-b+5)(-a+2)\) 後，哪個選項依次正確列出次數及項數？
questions.solution: The expansion is \[\begin{gathered}-4a^3 +8a^2 +ab -2b \\ -5a +10\end{gathered}\]. It has degree 3 and 6 terms.

questions.stem: Factorise \(xy+xz-7y-7z\).
questions.solution: Group as \(x(y+z)-7(y+z)\) and factor out \(y+z\). The result is \((y+z)(x-7)\).

questions.stem: Factorise \(5(x+y)^2-10(x+y)z\).
questions.solution: The common factor is \(5(x+y)\). Dividing each term by it leaves \((x+y)-2z\), hence \(5(x+y)(x+y-2z)\).
questions.solutionZh: 公因式為 \(5(x+y)\)；各項除以它後餘下 \((x+y)-2z\)，因此得 \(5(x+y)(x+y-2z)\)。

questions.stem: Factorise \(14x^4y^3+18x^2y\).
questions.solution: Extract the greatest common factor \(2x^2y\). The remaining terms are \(7x^2y^2\) and 9.
questions.solutionZh: 提出最大公因式 \(2x^2y\)，餘下兩項為 \(7x^2y^2\) 及 9。

questions.stem: Factorise \(-10a^3+14a^2+4a\).
questions.solution: Extract \(-2a\). Dividing each original term gives \(5a^2,-7a,-2\), hence \(-2a(5a^2-7a-2)\).

questions.solution: Extract \(2(a+1)\) to obtain \(2(a+1)[3(a+1)-2]\). Simplifying the bracket gives \(2(a+1)(3a+1)\).

questions.stem: Factorise \(m(3n-1)-m^2(1-3n)\).
questions.solution: Use \(1-3n=-(3n-1)\). The expression becomes \[\begin{gathered}m(3n-1) +m^2(3n-1) \\ =m(3n-1)(1+m)\end{gathered}\].

classification.difficultyReason: Recognise a shared bracket or opposite bracket, then simplify the remaining expression.

questions.stem: Factorise \[\begin{gathered}3(a-b)^2(a+b) \\ -4a^2(b-a)\end{gathered}\].
questions.solution: Use \(b-a=-(a-b)\), then extract \(a-b\). The remaining expression is \[\begin{gathered}3(a-b)(a+b) +4a^2 \\ =7a^2 -3b^2\end{gathered}\]. Thus the factorisation is \((a-b)(7a^2-3b^2)\).
questions.solutionZh: 利用 \(b-a=-(a-b)\)，提出 \(a-b\)。餘式為 \[\begin{gathered}3(a-b)(a+b) +4a^2 \\ =7a^2 -3b^2\end{gathered}\]，所以得 \((a-b)(7a^2-3b^2)\)。

questions.stem: Factorise \(8ab-2cd-2bc+8ad\).
questions.solution: Group as \(8a(b+d)-2c(b+d)\). Extracting the common binomial gives \(2(b+d)(4a-c)\).
questions.solutionZh: 分組為 \(8a(b+d)-2c(b+d)\)，提出共同二項式得 \(2(b+d)(4a-c)\)。

questions.stem: The remainder when a polynomial \(f(x)\) is divided by \(4x-6\) is \(8\). Find the remainder when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(3-2x\).
questions.stemZh: 多項式 \(f(x)\) 被 \(4x-6\) 除時餘式為 \(8\)。求 \(f(x)\) 被 \(3-2x\) 除時的餘式。
questions.solution: Both \(4x-6=0\) and \(3-2x=0\) give \(x=\frac{3}{2}\). The divisors share the same root, so both remainders equal \(f(\frac{3}{2})=8\).
questions.solutionZh: \(4x-6=0\) 與 \(3-2x=0\) 都給 \(x=\frac{3}{2}\)。兩個除式有同一個 root，所以餘式同為 \(f(\frac{3}{2})=8\)。。
